title: Glowing drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='drumBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF6B6B'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#CC3333'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='drumTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFCC66'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF9933'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='40' ry='35' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Drum body -->
  <rect x='28' y='38' width='44' height='38' rx='6' fill='url(#drumBody)'/>

  <!-- Body shine -->
  <rect x='32' y='42' width='10' height='30' rx='4' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Drum top rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='22' ry='9' fill='#FF9933'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='22' ry='9' fill='url(#drumTop)'/>

  <!-- Drum top surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='16' ry='6' fill='#FFDD88'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='16' ry='6' fill='#FFF0B3' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Top surface highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='36' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Drum bottom rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='22' ry='7' fill='#AA2222'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='18' ry='5' fill='#881111'/>

  <!-- Tension lines on body -->
  <line x1='36' y1='42' x2='36' y2='75' stroke='#FFAA44' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='43' x2='50' y2='76' stroke='#FFAA44' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='42' x2='64' y2='75' stroke='#FFAA44' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Drumstick left -->
  <line x1='14' y1='28' x2='38' y2='44' stroke='#CC8844' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='28' r='4' fill='#FFCC66'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='28' r='2.5' fill='#FFE599'/>

  <!-- Drumstick right -->
  <line x1='86' y1='24' x2='62' y2='42' stroke='#CC8844' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='24' r='4' fill='#FFCC66'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#FFE599'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='50' r='2' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='52' r='1.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='70' r='1.5' fill='#FFD633'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='2' fill='#FFD633'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='88' r='1.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
</svg>
